title: Robotaxi Cost per Mile vs. Revenue per Mile (2024-2030)
executive_question: When will robotaxis achieve unit economic breakeven?
required_metrics: Cost per mile (USD): Waymo, Cruise, Baidu Apollo
Revenue per mile (USD): Waymo, Cruise, Baidu Apollo
comparison_set: Waymo vs. Cruise vs. Baidu Apollo
preferred_sources: Waymo annual reports and safety reports
Cruise blog posts and investor updates
search_queries: Waymo cost per mile 2024 annual report
Cruise revenue per mile 2024
Baidu Apollo robotaxi pricing per mile
data_quality_rule: Use only publicly reported figures from company filings or official announcements. If annual data is missing for some years, interpolate using CAGR from available endpoints and mark as estimate.
narrative_role: Demonstrate the declining cost curve and revenue trajectory to pinpoint the breakeven year.
pre_exhibit_context: We claim robotaxis will be commercially viable by 2027. This chart tests that claim by comparing cost and revenue per mile over time.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Robotaxis are on track to breakeven around 2027, with costs falling below $0.50/mile and revenue stabilizing near $0.60/mile.

title: Autonomous Trucking Cost Savings per Mile (Traditional vs. Autonomous)
executive_question: How much cost reduction can autonomous trucking deliver?
required_metrics: Cost per mile (USD) for traditional long-haul trucking: driver, fuel, maintenance, insurance, other
Cost per mile (USD) for autonomous trucking: same categories, with driver cost replaced by remote ops and technology amortization
Year: 2024 or latest available
preferred_sources: American Transportation Research Institute (ATRI) operational costs report
McKinsey or BCG reports on autonomous trucking economics
search_queries: ATRI trucking operational cost per mile 2024
TuSimple autonomous trucking cost savings per mile
autonomous trucking total cost of ownership breakdown
data_quality_rule: Use ATRI data for traditional costs; for autonomous, use company pilot data or consulting estimates. Clearly label estimates.
narrative_role: Quantify the value proposition of autonomous trucking by breaking down cost components.
pre_exhibit_context: We hypothesize autonomous trucking will reduce long-haul costs by 30% by 2026. This exhibit validates that claim.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Autonomous trucking can save $0.30-$0.50 per mile, primarily from eliminating driver costs and improving fuel efficiency.

title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Level 4 AV Features (US, China, Europe)
executive_question: What price premium can OEMs charge for Level 4 autonomy?
required_metrics: Region: US, China, Europe
Willingness to pay (USD) for Level 4 autonomy feature
Survey year: 2024
preferred_sources: J.D. Power 2024 Mobility Confidence Index Study
search_queries: J.D. Power willingness to pay autonomous driving 2024
Deloitte global automotive consumer study 2024 autonomous driving
McKinsey consumer survey autonomous driving price premium
data_quality_rule: Use survey data from reputable firms. If multiple surveys exist, average them and note range.
narrative_role: Show that consumer willingness to pay is below $5,000, limiting personal AV adoption to luxury segments.
pre_exhibit_context: We claim consumers will pay less than $5,000 for Level 4. This exhibit tests that threshold across regions.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Willingness to pay averages $3,000-$4,000, insufficient for mass-market adoption; personal AVs will remain niche.

title: AV Deployment Milestones by Segment and Player (2018-2030)
executive_question: When will each AV segment reach key milestones?
required_metrics: Milestone: first driverless ride, first commercial deployment, first city-wide service, first interstate trucking
Entity: Waymo, Cruise, Baidu, TuSimple, Tesla
Date: actual (2018-2024) and projected (2025-2030)
comparison_set: Robotaxi vs. Autonomous Trucking vs. Personal AV
preferred_sources: Industry timelines from SAE or AVIA
search_queries: Waymo driverless ride history timeline
Cruise commercial deployment date
TuSimple autonomous trucking highway milestone
data_quality_rule: Use only confirmed dates from official sources. Projections must be attributed to company guidance or analyst consensus.
narrative_role: Provide a visual roadmap of actual and projected milestones to ground the timeline discussion.
pre_exhibit_context: We need to establish a credible timeline for Level 4/5 adoption across robotaxi, trucking, and personal AV.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Robotaxis lead, with commercial service in 10+ cities by 2027; autonomous trucking follows on highways by 2026; personal AVs lag until 2035.

title: Lidar Cost per Unit Forecast (2020-2028)
executive_question: Will lidar costs drop below $500 by 2026?
required_metrics: Lidar cost per unit (USD): Luminar, Hesai, Valeo
preferred_sources: Luminar Technologies earnings calls and investor presentations
Valeo annual report and press releases
search_queries: Luminar lidar cost per unit 2024 earnings call
Hesai lidar price volume 2024 annual report
Valeo lidar cost reduction roadmap
data_quality_rule: Use company-reported average selling prices. For forecast years, use company guidance or analyst consensus. Mark projections as estimates.
narrative_role: Track lidar cost reduction to validate the hypothesis that sensor costs will enable mass-market AV.
pre_exhibit_context: We claim lidar costs will fall below $500 by 2026. This chart tests that claim with historical and forecast data.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Lidar costs are on track to reach $500 by 2026, driven by volume and solid-state technology.

required_metrics: Funding amount (USD billions) by segment: robotaxi, autonomous trucking, personal AV, other
Number of deals per segment
comparison_set: Robotaxi vs. Autonomous Trucking vs. Personal AV vs. Other
search_queries: PitchBook autonomous vehicle funding 2024
CB Insights robotaxi funding 2024
autonomous trucking startup funding 2024
